lyrics.hi: तौबा तौबा, dil tera kyun mera hua
lyrics.en: Tauba tauba, why did your heart become mine?

lyrics.hi: Tujhpe fida main, har pal yeh kehta raha
lyrics.en: I'm devoted to you, I kept saying every moment

lyrics.hi: Teri aankhon mein dooba sa jahan hai mera
lyrics.en: My world is lost in your eyes

lyrics.hi: Tere bina ab kahan hai mera
lyrics.en: Without you, where am I now?

lyrics.hi: Tauba tauba, dil tera kyun mera hua
lyrics.en: Tauba tauba, why did your heart become mine?

lyrics.hi: Raaton ko tera naam likha hai chaand pe
lyrics.en: Nights write your name on the moon

lyrics.hi: Sapno mein tu, har subah tu hi mila
lyrics.en: You in dreams, every morning I find you

lyrics.hi: Satranga sa ye jahan, rang tere hi toh hain
lyrics.en: This world is seven-colored, all shades are yours

lyrics.hi: Tu jo hai saath mera, har pal suhana lagta
lyrics.en: With you beside me, every moment feels beautiful

lyrics.hi: Dil ki dhadkan tera naam le ke chale
lyrics.en: My heartbeat walks calling your name

lyrics.hi: Tere bina adhura sa yeh jahan lagta
lyrics.en: Without you this world feels incomplete

lyrics.hi: Satranga sa ye dil, tujhpe hi toh hai
lyrics.en: This heart is seven-colored, all for you

lyrics.hi: Tera saaya har raah pe saath chale
lyrics.en: Your shadow walks with me on every path

lyrics.hi: Khalasi, khalasi, samandar ki leheron pe
lyrics.en: Sailor, sailor, on the waves of the ocean

lyrics.hi: Chal diya dil mera apne ghar ko
lyrics.en: My heart set off toward its home

lyrics.hi: Dhoondhe kinara, dhoondhe kinara
lyrics.en: Searching for the shore, searching for the shore

lyrics.hi: Raah mein tera naam, raah mein tera chehra
lyrics.en: Your name on the path, your face on the path

lyrics.hi: Khalasi, khalasi, le chal mujhe door
lyrics.en: Sailor, sailor, take me far away

lyrics.hi: Jahan tu ho wahan mera ghar hai
lyrics.en: Where you are, that is my home

lyrics.hi: Chaleya chaleya, dil ke paas tu aaya
lyrics.en: You came close to my heart

lyrics.hi: Jaane kyun, jaane kyun ye dil gaya
lyrics.en: Don't know why, this heart fell for you

lyrics.hi: Teri baahon mein khoya sa main rahun
lyrics.en: Let me stay lost in your arms

lyrics.hi: Har pal tera naam, har saans tera
lyrics.en: Your name every moment, you in every breath

lyrics.hi: Chaleya chaleya, tere ishq mein main
lyrics.en: I walked into your love

lyrics.hi: Tujhse juda ab kuch bhi na chahun
lyrics.en: I want nothing apart from you now

lyrics.hi: O Maahi, O Maahi, tera mera rishta purana
lyrics.en: O Maahi, our bond is old and deep

lyrics.hi: Dil se dil ka jo hai silsila
lyrics.en: The thread that ties heart to heart

lyrics.hi: Tujh bin jeena ab mushkil sa lagta
lyrics.en: Living without you feels impossible now

lyrics.hi: Teri yaadon mein khoya rehta hoon
lyrics.en: I stay lost in memories of you

lyrics.hi: O Maahi, O Maahi, tu hi meri duniya
lyrics.en: O Maahi, you are my whole world

lyrics.hi: Saath tera chahun har pal har lamha
lyrics.en: I want you with me every moment

songs.title: I Think They Call This Love
songs.album: I Think They Call This Love
